Moreover, genes implicated in delta cell development were not captured well by scVelo’s model of splicing kinetics (Extended Data Fig. 7b). We hypothesize that splic - ing kinetics fail to capture delta cell differentiation because these cells appear late in pancreatic development and thus are very rare in our data 37. The development of delta cells is not well understood 33.
